equipment.name: 冰风迷途的勇士
equipment.bonus: 2件套：获得15%冰元素伤害加成。4件套：攻击冻结状态的敌人时，暴击率提高20%。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: +15% Cryo DMG Bonus. 4-piece: CRIT Rate increased by 20% against frozen enemies.
equipment.description: 冰系角色首选套装，配合永冻队使用效果最佳。
equipment.descriptionEn: Best-in-slot for Cryo characters, excels in permafreeze teams.

equipment.name: 炽烈的炎之魔女
equipment.bonus: 2件套：获得15%火元素伤害加成。4件套：超载、燃烧、绽放反应造成的伤害提升40%，蒸发、融化反应的加成系数提升15%。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: +15% Pyro DMG Bonus. 4-piece: Overloaded, Burning, Bloom DMG increased by 40%, Vaporize and Melt DMG increased by 15%.
equipment.description: 火系输出角色通用套装，反应流首选。
equipment.descriptionEn: Universal set for Pyro DPS, best for reaction-focused builds.

equipment.name: 绝缘之旗印
equipment.bonus: 2件套：元素充能效率提高20%。4件套：元素爆发造成的伤害提高25%，该效果基于元素充能效率的140%为上限。
equipment.bonusEn: 2-piece: Energy Recharge +20%. 4-piece: Elemental Burst DMG increased by 25% of Energy Recharge, up to 75%.
equipment.description: 依赖元素爆发的角色首选，副C和充电宝适用。
equipment.descriptionEn: Best for characters dependent on Elemental Burst, suitable for sub-DPS and battery roles.
